shots.note: wide push_in: Two pilgrims walk along the bright river ghats of Kashi at sunrise toward a temple tower, under the title card; the woman folds her hands on 'Kashi'.
medium tilt_up: Closer on the pilgrim at the water's edge: he closes his eyes in prayer on 'freed' and gold motes rise off him like a weight lifting.
medium crane_down: An iris opens on a gold heaven: five-headed Brahma sits on his pink lotus between gold pillars and lifts his chin with pride on 'creator'.
close push_in: Close on Brahma's heads: the fifth head on top is lit by a gold halo ring that opens on 'five'.
medium handheld: Shiva lunges forward in fury, red eyes and trishul, in a red storm sky; a red pulse bursts behind him on 'rage'.
medium push_in: Shiva, now still, looks down at his left hand: Brahma's serene severed head, eyes closed, clings to it in a soft violet light.
medium tilt_down: Flashback iris: Narada with his veena points in anger; a red pulse spreads from his hand on 'curse' and his name appears as it is spoken.
medium push_in: Brahma sits on his lotus as a violet mist curls round him on 'desire'; his face clouds with doubt, then fear on 'not'.
two_shot dolly_right: On 'created' Brahma opens his arms on the lotus and Brahmi takes shape from rose-gold light beside him, folding her hands on 'Brahmi'.
close static: Close on Brahma's heads: the sky behind turns violet on 'curse' and his eyes fix sideways, still, on 'hold'; nothing else is shown.
two_shot pan_right: Brahmi, at a distance from Brahma, notices his gaze on 'saw', lowers her eyes and turns away on 'moved', walking out of his reach.
medium dolly_left: Brahmi walks across the cloud floor with her eyes lowered, her face turned from where Brahma is; a pale violet light follows her.
medium tilt_up: Standing Brahma, eyes turned sideways; on 'grew' a fifth head rises on top of his crown inside a halo ring, facing where she went.
two_shot dolly_right: Marichi raises a warning hand and Atri points sternly toward their father off-frame; each name appears as it is spoken.
medium pull_out: Brahmi stands in a meadow; on 'became' she fades in a ring of light and a white cow wearing her gold necklace stands in her place, facing away from Brahma.
wide pan_left: A palomino mare with Brahmi's necklace trots left across the meadow behind, and a cream duck with the same gold necklace takes shape in front as the forms keep changing.
wide crane_up: A spotted doe with Brahmi's necklace steps left in front; behind her in the haze stand her earlier forms, cow and mare, as glowing halo rings multiply on 'hundred'.
close push_in: Close on Brahmi's calm face inside a rose-gold halo ring, eyes gently lowered; the name Shatarupa appears above her as it is spoken.
low_angle tilt_up: A white flash and Shiva stands in his rage stance with trishul and red eyes against a red storm sky; lightning forks far behind on 'fury'.
two_shot crane_down: Stacked: furious Shiva above glares down; below, five-headed Brahma's face falls in shame on 'senses' and he bows with joined hands on 'begged'.
medium static: A blade of white light sweeps across the top of Brahma's crown on 'cut' with a bright flash; the fifth head is gone in the light and four-headed Brahma remains, eyes shut.
medium pull_out: Four-headed Brahma sits in prayer, eyes closed in remorse; on 'Vedas' the four glowing Veda books rise one by one in front of the gold clouds.
medium push_in: Shiva, still in his rage stance, freezes; on 'stopped' his fury drains into surprise and the red storm sky cools to dusk blue.
medium tilt_down: Shiva looks down at his left hand, where Brahma's serene head with closed eyes hangs fixed in a pale glow; he cannot shake it off.
medium dolly_left: Shiva's head bows in shame and a dull red shadow gathers behind him on 'sin' as the light around him dims.
medium pull_out: The white-bearded sage Atri speaks with an open teaching hand on 'action'; a slow gold yantra wheel turns behind him on 'result', the wheel of cause and effect.
medium dolly_right: Four-headed Brahma sits in quiet penance with eyes closed; a faint violet curse-mist drifts away behind him on 'curse'.
close push_in: Close on Shiva's face: he lowers his eyes and accepts it, the calm sad look of one who knows he must pay.
wide dolly_left: Shiva walks alone through the starry cosmos with the head fixed to his hand; on 'nothing' his face falls in grief.
medium push_in: Closer on Shiva and his hand: on 'away' the head softly dissolves in pale light and an ivory skull is left in its place.
medium tilt_up: Shiva stands full figure with the skull in his left hand inside a pale halo ring; the name Kapali appears above as it is spoken.
wide crane_down: A wipe to a bright river bank at sunrise with sandstone buildings and a temple tower: Shiva walks in from the left with the skull and looks up on 'Earth'.
medium push_in: On 'fell' a ring of gold light bursts from Shiva's left hand, the skull is gone from it and lies on the ground at his feet; his face lifts in relief.
two_shot pan_right: Pilgrims on the river ghats at sunrise fold their hands as gold motes rise from them on 'freed', their faces lifting in joy.
wide crane_up: Shiva, freed, stands calm and smiling on the ghat before the temple tower and the river at sunrise; the name Kashi appears as it is spoken.
wide pull_out: Back to the pilgrims of the opening: they walk on along the ghat toward the temple in the morning light, hands joined, the question answered.
